newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR rates nudge lower.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR rates nudge lower.

text.p: The Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) nudged lower on Wednesday for the fifth consecutive session in line with the soft trend in the money market, traders said.
But domestic interest rates are now seen bottoming out after the benchmark 91-day T-bill rate tumbled to a single-digit level of 9.804 percent last Monday from 10.159 percent, dealers said.
They added banks are still waiting for the Central Bank to slightly cut its key overnight borrowing rate of 10.0 percent before rates consolidate at current levels.
